scope: Reviewed corrections to published classes. Format ids and ordinals never change; the replaced values are kept in each class's metadata.

classes.reason: wma and wmv are classes of their own, and the ASF validator names them by stream codec; listing their extensions under asf made every .wma and .wmv path claim two classes.
pcapng is a distinct format with its own class and validator.
.tsv names tab-separated values, which the tsv class owns.
Every empty file has the same SHA-256, so the class can hold exactly one distinct sample.
A directory is a filesystem object, not file content; a whole-file corpus cannot hold one.
A symbolic link is a filesystem object, not file content; its stored-as-text form is the symlinktext class.
Magika's label for having no content type; there are no bytes that are this class.
Magika's label for an undetermined result, not a format any file has.
Magika's label for malformed input it could not read; no file content is this class by itself.
mun files are the same resource-only PE images with an MUI resource as mui files (file type 18 in both); merged.
Identical in content to mui (resource-only PE with an MUI resource of file type 18); merged into mui.
